intro.text: A spiritual tie between people, places and things. Feruchemists store it in duralumin, and medallions holding it let a wearer in a foreign land speak the local language.

description.text: A Feruchemist storing Connection becomes less noticed and less trusted by others; tapping it lets them form trusting relationships quickly.
A Bondsmith can touch another person to forge a spiritual Connection with them, briefly gaining the ability to speak whatever languages that person speaks.
Travelling far from something one is strongly Connected to brings a pulling sensation that grows stronger with distance.
Connection can be handled directly, stretched and checked for flaws, though stretching it too far risks wearing it down.
When made visible, Connection appears as glowing cords of light linking things together, which are hard to read or understand.
